summary: State forestry lookout at the Cajon Pass summit, built 1932: a small tower over living quarters, staffed in 1939, removed likely in the late 1980s; site today undescribed.

facts.design: small observation tower and catwalk mounted above living quarters
facts.status_note: Removed, likely in the late 1980s. No source describes what remains.
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record gives the removal year as 1980, while the register gives only 'the 1980s' and says the removal was likely in the late 1980s. The event year is kept at 1980 as the decade start, and the note says so. A reviewer may prefer to record it as the 1980s.

notes_for_editor: Built date 1932 is well supported by 1932 clippings. Removal is only 'the 1980s' per the register, likely late 1980s; the record's 1980 is a decade start, not a sourced year. Staffing evidence is one 1939 clipping about a transfer; no other staff or fires were found in the sources read. Nothing in the sources describes what remains at the summit or whether the spot is open to visitors. Two web searches turned up only general Route 66 and Interstate 15 material, which was not used. No photos added.
